gui.title: Anya Settings
gui.nav.label: Settings sections
gui.notready.text: Choose an engine and enter its credentials to start
gui.activity.subtitle: What you said and what was recognized, kept on this computer.
gui.activity.empty: Nothing yet. Press the dictation hotkey and speak; each recognition and its result shows up here.
gui.route.subtitle: Where the sound comes from right now, which engine it goes to, and where the text goes.
gui.route.idle: No sound is coming in and no text is going out
gui.route.caption: Only the lines to an engine leave this computer · hover a source to light its route alone
gui.route.log_note: Not saved; cleared when Anya restarts
gui.route.log_empty: No messages yet. Dictate, turn on continuous transcription or let a paired app speak, and each step shows up here.
gui.notice.config_broken: Settings file changed but cannot be read; the previous settings stay
gui.notice.delivery_failed: Delivering the text failed; it may still be on the clipboard
gui.notice.plugins_unavailable: Plugins are enabled but Bun is missing, so they are not running
gui.notice.overlay_unavailable: The recording overlay could not start
gui.dictation.subtitle: Press the hotkey and speak; when you finish, the text goes to the field you are in.
gui.hotkey.label: Hotkey
gui.hotkey.help: Global hotkeys pause while recording; Fn can be recorded too.
gui.hotkey.recording: Press the new combination… Esc to cancel
gui.hotkey.unrecordable: This key cannot be a hotkey ({code})
gui.mode.label: Mode
gui.mode.help_toggle: Press once to start, again to finish
gui.mode.help_hold: Talk while holding, release to finish
gui.stop_delay.label: Keep recording after release
gui.stop_delay.help: So the last word is not cut off
gui.device.label: Input device
gui.output.label: Where the text goes
gui.continuous.subtitle: Transcribes in the background for the apps subscribed to it; no overlay, nothing typed into your fields.
gui.continuous.device_help: System sound is captured by Anya itself; no virtual sound card is needed.
gui.continuous.permission_note: The first time needs the “Screen & System Audio Recording” permission.
gui.continuous.silence_help: Nothing is sent while it is quiet; sentences are cut at pauses
gui.continuous.footer: Turning it off releases the device; connected apps are told “stopped” and stay connected.
gui.engine.subtitle: Set up several recognition services; dictation, continuous and phones each pick one.
gui.engine.custom: An engine this Anya does not have
gui.engine.group_uses: Which one is used for what
gui.engine.use_dictation_hint: What you say after the hotkey
gui.engine.use_continuous_hint: Meetings and the sound of videos
gui.engine.uses_note: Each recognition goes only to the one chosen here. If it fails you are told; no other service is tried.
gui.engine.choice_not_ready: {engine} is not set up yet, so it cannot be used.
gui.engine.enabled_help: When off, it cannot be chosen
gui.language.label: Recognition language
gui.language.help: The language you speak; with auto-detect the engine decides
gui.hotwords.label: Hotwords
gui.hotwords.help: Proper nouns, names, product names: words that should be recognized more accurately
gui.hotwords_file.label: Hotwords file
gui.hotwords_file.help: An outside word list, one word per line, # starts a comment; merged with the hotwords above and read again at every session
gui.plugins.intro: A plugin adds a speech engine or dictation hooks. Install and enable are separate steps: an enabled plugin receives what its kinds listed above say, and one that runs in Bun does so with your rights
gui.plugins.disabled_note: Installed but off: it receives nothing until you enable it
gui.plugins.state_host_down: Not running: the plugin host is down
gui.overlay.subtitle: Shows the state and the recognized words on screen while you dictate.
gui.position.label: Position
gui.position.help: Notch (a screen without one uses top center)
gui.overlay.preview_help: Click it to try it at its real place on screen, without recording
gui.apps.subtitle: Meeting notes, live captions and translation apps can subscribe to what Anya hears.
gui.subscription.label: Address
gui.subscription.help: This computer only: 127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost, or unix:<path>.
gui.lan.label: LAN sharing
gui.lan.help: Lets paired apps on your local network (an iPhone, a browser, another computer) send their microphone audio to Anya and get the text back. Connections use TLS and need a token from pairing
gui.lan.port_help: The TCP port the LAN listener uses
gui.apps.label: Paired apps
gui.apps.need_lan: Turn on LAN sharing to add an app
gui.apps.remove_confirm: Remove this app? It will have to pair again
gui.apps.scope_dictate_help: Send its microphone audio for dictation and get the text back
gui.apps.scope_dictation_help: Receive every dictation session, also yours and other apps'
gui.pairing.title: Add an app
gui.pairing.intro: Scan the code with the app, or type the six digits. The code works once and expires soon
gui.pairing.qr_failed: Cannot draw the QR code. Type the code instead
gui.general.subtitle: Language, input gain and where the settings live.
gui.ui_language.label: Interface language
gui.gain.label: Input gain
gui.gain.help: Applies to dictation and continuous transcription
gui.config.label: Settings file
gui.config.help: You can edit it by hand; changes apply as soon as it is saved
gui.version.label: Version
gui.debug.label: Debug mode
gui.quit.label: Quit
gui.panel.empty: No dictation yet. Press the hotkey and speak.
gui.panel.stop_hint_toggle: Press {hotkey} to finish · Esc to cancel
gui.panel.stop_hint_hold: Release to finish · Esc to cancel
gui.panel.not_ready: Choose a recognition engine and enter its credentials to start.
gui.web.link_expired: This link has expired. Use the link Anya printed when it started.
gui.web.sign_in: Open this page with the link Anya printed when it started.
gui.plugins.subtitle: Add recognition services and dictation hooks with plugins. They install switched off; turn one on and it starts working.
gui.plugins.install_intro: It installs switched off and receives nothing until you enable it. Enabled, it will receive:
gui.market.unreachable: The plugin market is unreachable right now
gui.market.unreachable_help: Plugins you installed keep working. Check your network and try again.
gui.debug.help: Record key presses and the timing of each recognition in the activity log, to help find problems
gui.update.label: Updates
gui.update.available_other: Anya {version} is available. Update it where you installed Anya from.
gui.update.restart: Upgraded to Anya {version}. Restart Anya to use it.
gui.update.upgraded: Upgrade finished. Restart Anya to use the new version.
gui.update.issue_not_homebrew: This Anya was not installed with Homebrew, so it cannot upgrade itself. Update it where you installed it from.
gui.update.issue_brew_missing: Homebrew was not found on this computer.
gui.update.issue_nothing: There is no newer version to install.
gui.update.check.label: Check for updates
gui.update.check.help: Once a day, Anya asks the Homebrew tap's website whether a newer version exists. The request carries only Anya's version number, nothing else. When this is off, Anya makes no such request.
gui.plugins.enable_intro: Enabling is where it starts receiving. Enabled, it will receive:
gui.plugins.gets_engine: Speech engine: the audio of every session opened on it
gui.plugins.gets_context: Context hook: which app is focused when you dictate
gui.plugins.gets_transform: Transform hook: everything you dictate, as text
gui.plugins.gets_action: Action hook: everything you dictate, as text
gui.plugins.runs_inline: Runs inside Anya: it only processes text and cannot reach the network or the disk
gui.plugins.runs_host: Runs in Bun with your rights
gui.plugins.provides_none: What it provides shows once it has loaded
gui.hooks.title: Dictation hooks
gui.hooks.intro: What runs on a dictation, in this order: context hooks before it opens, transform hooks on the final text, then actions. Move context and transform hooks to change their order.
gui.hooks.empty: No hooks run on a dictation
gui.hooks.replace_help: Rewrites spoken words in the final text with the list below
gui.hooks.community_help: Runs every enabled plugin's context, transform and action hooks; off, none of them run
gui.hooks.replacements_file_help: A file next to the config file, one “spoken => written” per line, # starts a comment, \n and \t stand for a new line and a tab on the written side; read again when it changes
gui.hook.failure_busy: was too far behind and was dropped
gui.hook.failure_unknown: failed for a reason this Anya does not know
gui.hook.stalled: Plugin {plugin} stopped answering and was restarted
